subject: P1 incident: checkout API 500s spiking since 08:12 UTC

messages.body:
HIGH urgency incident triggered on checkout-service (prod-eu).

Error rate: 27% of requests returning HTTP 500 over the last 5 minutes (baseline < 0.5%). First affected trace at 08:12:41 UTC. Region: eu-west-1 only.

Assignee: on-call backend (you). Escalation policy: backend-primary, 5 min. Acknowledge in the PagerDuty app or reply to this email.

Confirming the spike correlates with v2.14.0, which shipped at 07:58 UTC. I'm rolling the deploy back now and watching the error dashboard.

Can you own incident comms and verify EU recovery once the rollback lands? I need an answer before the 09:15 incident standup so we can split the roles.

Two of our top-10 accounts have hit this in the last half hour and support tickets are climbing.

I need an ETA for full recovery and a two-line customer note I can send to key accounts by 10:00. Please reply to this thread with both, even if the ETA is rough.

HR just opened the Q3 review cycle in Lattice, and your self-assessment is due Wednesday, Sep 9, end of day.

For the form, I'd like: two wins with impact numbers, one growth area, and a one-paragraph status on the billing-exporter migration. I use these directly in Thursday's calibration session, so specifics beat adjectives.

If the Lattice link doesn't work, tell me and I'll raise it with HR — it was flaky for half the team last quarter.

Quick nudge before the week fills up — the self-review is due Wednesday EOD and I know you have the incident on your plate this morning.

I've added 30 minutes to Thursday's 1:1 for calibration prep, so having your draft in Lattice by then would be ideal. Ping me if you want to talk through the growth-area section.

subject: Notes: Platform team weekly sync — Sep 4

messages.body:

4. Hiring: two backend offers are out, one accepted.

No action needed from most of you — only the billing-exporter owners have a deadline (Sep 11 sign-off). Full doc in the usual Drive folder.

subject: Re: Northwind x Vendorly — 500-seat renewal quote (expires Sep 12)

messages.body:
Hi,

Following up on our call last week — the formal renewal quote is attached.

Summary: 500 seats, $84,500/year, a 3% uplift over your current contract, same SLA tier. The quote is valid until Sep 12, after which list pricing applies.

Could you confirm your intent to renew, or let me know if procurement needs anything else from us (W-9, SOC 2 report, security questionnaire — all can go out today)?

Just floating this back to the top of your inbox — the quote expires Sep 12, so this week is the window to lock it in.

One update: I can do 2.5% uplift if you commit to two years, or hold at 3% for a one-year term. Would a 15-minute call Tuesday or Wednesday work to close this out? I'll send a calendar hold once you confirm.

messages.body:
